rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive construction for something located on or relating to the right side.

example.jyutping: jau6 bin1 ge3 mun4 so2 zo2

rows.note: Use this when a person or activity uses the right hand, such as a right-handed bowler.

example.english: This right-hand bowler always bowls accurately.
example.traditional: 呢個用右手嘅投球手成日投得好準。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jung6 jau6 sau2 ge3 tau4 kau4 sau2 sing4 jat6 tau4 dak1 hou2 zeon2

rows.jyutping: ngaam1 jau6 sau2 jung6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for an object designed or suitable for use by the right hand, such as right-handed scissors.

example.english: These right-hand scissors feel very comfortable to use.
example.traditional: 呢把啱右手用嘅剪刀好順手。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 ngaam1 jau6 sau2 jung6 ge3 zin2 dou1 hou2 seon6 sau2
